simple.texte:
Cinema Public – Contact us Cinema Public
Contact us
Cinéma Public brings you a programme of films on the big screen at the 
Casa d’Italia <https://goo.gl/maps/V99JeMCB3WujbouU7>
. During the summer, we also present open-air screenings in the 
Livart <https://maps.app.goo.gl/3UXfKqZ6X9P7xF5P8>
 courtyard. Doors open 30 minutes before the start of the first screening.
Write to us <mailto:info@cinemapublic.ca>
In theatre
Casa d’Italia
505 Jean-Talon St. Est
Montréal (QC) H2R 1T6
Entrance on Berri
Jean-Talon Metro
Exit: Jean-Talon North, Berri Street
info@cinemapublic.ca <mailto:info@cinemapublic.ca>
(514) 272-1040
Find on Google Maps <https://www.google.com/maps/place/Cin%C3%A9ma+Public/@45.5393173,-73.6141366,15z/data=!4m5!3m4!1s0x0:0xe9e98e457e472de3!8m2!3d45.5393173!4d-73.6141366?shorturl=1>
To get to Cinéma Public, choose sustainable transportation!
By metro.
 The north exit of Jean-Talon Station (orange and blue lines) is literally across the street!
By bike.
 We are just a few pedal strokes away from the Saint-Denis axis of the express bicycle network (REV) as well as other bicycle paths (De Châteaubriand, Bélanger, Boyer).
By bus.
 North-South: 30, 31, 361. East-West: 92, 93, 95, 99, 372.
Outdoor
Livart
3980 Saint-Denis St.
Montréal (QC), H2W 2M2
Access to the courtyard via the alley
Sherbrooke Metro
info@cinemapublic.ca <mailto:info@cinemapublic.ca>
(514) 272-1040
Find on Google Maps <https://maps.app.goo.gl/eFmPMttxzuiweUy49>
For information on 
private rentals
 or 
volunteering opportunities
, please contact us at 
info@cinemapublic.ca <mailto:info@cinemapublic.ca>
. For 
spontaneous application
, please send your CV and covering letter to 
rh@cinemapublic.ca <mailto:rh@cinemapublic.ca>
. Our offices are located at 911 Jean-Talon St. East, local 206, Montréal (QC), H2R 1V5. To contact a 
member of our team
, visit our 
About us <https://cinemapublic.ca/en/about/>
 page.
Cinéma Public, 
a cinema on the move
Stay informed!

three periods
